caption: The drawing depicts a metal coffee pot with a maroon-brown body, rounded lid, long curved spout, and a large, curved handle. The coffee pot has decorative bands around the lid and base colored in light olive green, adorned with a repeating linked motif in yellow and brown. On the side of the pot, there is an oval-shaped area featuring a floral pattern with yellow, red, and orange stylized flowers, surrounded by green leaves on a light background. The surface of the pot shows a textured look suggesting metallic sheen. The pot is centered on a plain, off-white or beige background with the name "WAYNE WHITE" printed in small letters below the illustration.
title: Coffeepot
